t2.thesis: LYFT enters earnings after an ~11% sympathy jump on Uber's results and a strong 1-month run, leaving the implied ~10% move fairly priced with no clear directional edge.
reasons: Base rate ~54% for buy-everything on AMC consumer names.
Stock rallied ~19% in 1m and ~15% in 5d, including an 11% sympathy jump on Uber's print, so good news is partly priced in by the entry open.
Fundamentals are strong: Q2 gross bookings +23%, record riders, EBITDA margin expansion, and Q3 guidance was reaffirmed in September.
Short interest is high at ~22% of float, which supports upside squeezes on a good print.
New CFO and AV competition concerns add event risk, and the implied move is large at ~10%, so the distribution is wide.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 gross bookings and EBITDA guidance relative to elevated expectations after the rally, plus AV and Uber read-through commentary.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542, AMC 0.538, consumer cluster 0.555; blended ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-04, so the 2026-11-05 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how LYFT's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 4 points from 0.54: the run-up and the Uber sympathy rally raise the bar for the print, offset partly by high short interest and solid fundamentals.

theses.expected: Beat with Q4 guide at or above consensus, stock gaps up
theses.mechanism: Bookings growth near 20% and margin expansion, with a short squeeze given 22% short interest
theses.wrong_if: Q4 EBITDA guide midpoint is below consensus or bookings growth decelerates sharply

theses.expected: Sell the news after the run-up
theses.mechanism: The stock is up about 19% in a month, and Uber's soft profit outlook sets a cautious tone for the group
theses.wrong_if: Management raises targets and the stock opens higher despite the run

theses.expected: Flat to slightly down reaction on mixed signals
theses.mechanism: The first print with the new CFO, Waymo and AV competition worries, and an EPS miss history (two of the last three) cap enthusiasm
theses.wrong_if: Clean beat on all metrics with an upbeat AV partnership update

key_observations: Q4 gross bookings and adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus
Rides and active rider growth, and the Freenow international contribution
AV partnership updates (Waymo Nashville, depot opening) and competitive commentary
New CFO tone and margin trajectory
